Subject: Pilot readiness: calendar alignment, SSO test, procurement checklist

Hi Samira — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum toward a short pilot (3-week technical POC):

Recap from discovery call:
- Primary goal: validate inference latency and integration with your private SSO + data handling constraints for the patient-facing analytics pipeline.
- Success criteria: sub-200ms p95 for typical payloads, SSO handshake complete in a staging environment, and procurement sign-off on terms.

Proposed next steps (pick one slot):
- Option A: Tue Apr 13, 11:00–12:00 PT — technical deep dive + initial SSO test
- Option B: Wed Apr 14, 13:00–14:00 ET — combined tech + procurement overview (short procurement checklist review)

Could you confirm availability and share the best contact for IT security and procurement (name + email)? If it helps, I attached a one-page pilot checklist and our standard POC terms.

Attachments: pilot-checklist.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-poc-terms.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — I’ll loop in our platform engineer and solutions lead once we have contacts and a confirmed time.

Best,
